verdict.rationale: Vendor docs say each dot has its own cloud computer and browser. It handles website logins through a private credential form with optional saved passwords, and users can take over and return control of its computer, so it clearly operates a browser to work on websites for the user. missing for 10: explicit documentation of web-research and multi-step website task workflows (browsing is implied rather than described in depth), and independent or hands-on corroboration of browser task completion.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant operate a web browser on my behalf to research and complete tasks on websites

citations.quote: your dot lives in the cloud and has its own computer and browser.
When a website needs a login, your dot can send a request with a private form. Enter your credentials there
When offered, Save to Passwords lets you save a login for future sign-ins.
open its computer and select Take over. Select Return control when you're ready for your dot to continue.
